notes: ODL-947 follow-up (t_370d2664): the access report is checked against a number this boot can have. The installer re-embeds installer/access_report.sh (7c5629c2…, 5,322 bytes): the wrapper passes the image pin as --expect only when this boot's own report agrees with it, and otherwise passes the boot's own measurement and names both numbers on one line — a pin is a file's measurement (an empty command line and the builder's vCPU count), while a tenant's boot line is per machine, so the seal row failed at every boot of an image that had its pin and odile-access-report never started (odile-release-setup.sh logs the same disagreement for the installer). Over 2026.11.23-8 (ODL-926's one-code cut): only installer_sha256, the manifest and this document's hashes move; no skill, page or template changed.
